2. **GSM Tool Licenses & Activations (تفعيل البوكسات والدونجل والأدوات الرقمية)**:

   - DFT Pro Tool

2. **Remote Phone Unlocking & iCloud / FRP Bypass (خدمات فك الشفرات وتخطي الحسابات)**:
   - Apple iPhone / iPad iCloud Bypass (Signal / No Signal, MEID / GSM)

3. **IMEI & Check Services (تقارير فحص السيريال وIMEI)**:

4. **Reseller API Integration (ربط الـ API للموزعين وأصحاب السيرفرات)**:

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

- **Q: How fast are activations delivered?**
  A: Most digital tool activations and credits are fulfilled instantly to within 1-24 hours depending on the provider server.
- **Q: Can other servers connect via API?**
  A: Yes, resellers can connect via our standard Dhru-compatible REST API at `/api/v1/provider`.
- **Q: Is customer support available?**
  A: 24/7 dedicated human priority support is available on Telegram (@boraiserver) and WhatsApp.
